scope: Snapshot restore entry availability and first-click confirmation

reported_issue.observation: User screenshots show a ready snapshot with an enabled restore button, followed by an unconfigured coordinator message.

changes: Snapshot actions use the restore panel's observed service, installation, conflict and per-package availability.
Loading, unconfigured, offline, unregistered, maintenance, pending-task and request-error states are distinguished.
Disabled restore actions have a visible reason; snapshot export remains available.
A ready installation opens the selected snapshot confirmation on the first click.
Both the page refresh entry and snapshot-section refresh re-read restore availability.
Availability notifications are deduplicated and the initial empty snapshot input is stable, preventing a loading feedback loop.
The guide distinguishes daily service restart from starting the managed local rehearsal.

validation.browser_backend: controlled fixture; no real database restore performed in this UI regression

failed_attempt.reason: New availability events plus an unstable empty snapshot input caused a first-load update loop.
